module.name: sort-imports
module.description: Require grouped alphabetical imports without changing runtime dependency order.

scenarios.name: should allow imports ordered side-effect, then builtin, then external, then local
scenarios.given: a module with 'reflect-metadata' then 'node:path' then 'lodash' then './local' imports
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the import declarations

scenarios.name: should allow alphabetically sorted imports within the same group
scenarios.given: two external imports 'axios' then 'lodash' in the same group
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the import declarations

scenarios.name: should preserve explicit side-effect import order
scenarios.given: multiple side-effect-only imports appear in a deliberate source order
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the import declarations
scenarios.then: their relative order is accepted and never alphabetized

specifications.feature: Imports in the wrong group order

scenarios.name: should report an external import placed before a builtin import
scenarios.given: import 'lodash' appears before import 'node:path' in the source
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the import declarations

scenarios.name: should report imports within the same group that are not alphabetically sorted
scenarios.given: import 'lodash' appears before import 'axios' in the external group
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the import declarations

scenarios.name: should report a local import placed before an external import
scenarios.given: import './local' appears before import 'lodash' in the source
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the import declarations

scenarios.name: should autofix a complete import run in one pass without partial declarations
scenarios.given: five or more safely contiguous explicit import type declarations appear in reverse order
scenarios.when: the autofix sorts the declaration span
scenarios.then: one whole-span replacement retains every complete import and produces final order in one pass

scenarios.name: should report without autofixing unsafe import spans
scenarios.given: sorting would change the relative order of runtime imports or cross comments or executable code
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the import declarations
scenarios.then: ordering violations are reported but no autofix is offered

scenarios.name: should preserve runtime module initialization order
scenarios.given: out-of-order named, default, namespace, or bare imports may initialize shared module state
scenarios.when: ESLint evaluates the rule or applies its offered fix
scenarios.then: ordering diagnostics are reported without changing runtime dependency order

scenarios.name: should sort explicit type imports safely
scenarios.given: out-of-order import type declarations are contiguous and contain no intervening comments or executable statements
scenarios.when: ESLint evaluates the rule or applies its offered fix
scenarios.then: the whole span is sorted while the relative order of runtime imports is retained

scenarios.name: should reset collected imports between linted files
scenarios.given: the same linter processes an unsorted module followed by an empty or sorted module
scenarios.when: ESLint evaluates the rule or applies its offered fix
scenarios.then: the later module has no diagnostics inherited from the earlier import collection
